items.title: Rebel Wilson faces UK prosecution over uninsured Audi under Continuous Insurance Enforcement rules
items.summary: Actor Rebel Wilson is facing a UK criminal prosecution brought by the DVLA for failing to maintain motor insurance on an Audi Q5 left parked in a private London garage while she was overseas.

items.title: European aviation bomb hoaxes focus attention on war risk and terrorism cover
items.summary: A series of coordinated bomb hoaxes targeting European flights on November 4 has highlighted how multiple insurance lines respond to potential hybrid warfare threats.

items.title: Public Accounts Committee launches inquiry into Civil Service Pension Scheme
items.summary: The Public Accounts Committee has opened a formal probe into administrative failures at the Civil Service Pension Scheme following its takeover by Capita.

items.title: Fintech Door Ventures ceases operations amid financial constraints
items.summary: Asset and wealth management due diligence platform Door Ventures has closed down due to severe financial pressures.

items.title: Intact Financial reports Q3 profit decline amid weather losses and UK brand consolidation
items.summary: Intact Financial Corporation's third-quarter net income dropped to CA$562 million as weather catastrophes mounted, while its UK and Ireland operations held direct premiums flat at CA$1.078 billion.

items.title: Vencora acquires CT InsureTech to take permanent ownership of London market bordereaux platform
items.summary: Toronto-based software holding company Vencora has acquired CT InsureTech, bringing a buy-and-hold ownership model to the provider of delegated authority data infrastructure for The London insurance market.
